summary: Seven zones of one VivaCity camera (301) at the Noller Pde/Alfred St/River Rd intersection, Parramatta, Oct 2023-Mar 2026, with no counter changes. Faults are single-day duplicate loads (every slot even, often camera- or site-wide) that the automatic halving missed on several days, and timestamps that are in UTC rather than Sydney time; from 2025-02-06 the feed omits most zero slots (days show 20-35 valid slots) but daily totals remain continuous, so absent slots are zeros rather than missing. The bridge-path zone (427) steps up about tenfold from 2025-05-14; this is flagged as unresolved, and the Dec 2025 swap between the River Rd W path (422) and road (411) looks like a real diversion.
